 Hardy Sandhu Live at NSUT Moksha 2026: Date, Free Entry Passes, Metro Route, and Event Guide 
 October 28, 2026 
 Sahil Chopra 
 Punjabi pop icon and playback singer Hardy Sandhu is scheduled to perform live at Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), Dwarka, New Delhi, on October 30, 2026. The concert will serve as the star attraction for Moksha 2026, the annual cultural festival organized by the university. Known for chart-topping hits such as “Bijlee Bijlee” , “Naah” , and “Backbone” , Sandhu’s performance is expected to draw thousands of students and pop music enthusiasts from across the National Capital Region (NCR).
 Entry to the star night at NSUT Sports Ground is free of cost; however, mandatory advance registration is required to gain admittance to the university premises. Attendees can secure their digital entry passes exclusively via the official Instagram broadcast channel maintained by dufest_gram .
 Event Snapshot: Hardy Sandhu Live at Moksha 2026
 Event Parameter Official Details 
 Featured Artist Hardy Sandhu 
 Festival Name Moksha 2026 (Annual Cultural Fest of NSUT) 
 Performance Date October 30, 2026 
 Venue Main Sports Ground, Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), Azad Hind Fauj Marg, Sector 3, Dwarka, New Delhi – 110078 
 Entry Fee Free (Pass registration mandatory) 
 Pass Registration Portal Official Instagram Broadcast Channel ( dufest_gram ) 
 Nearest Metro Station Dwarka Mor (Delhi Metro Blue Line) 
 Target Audience University Students, General Public, and Music Fans 
 How to Get Free Registration Passes for Moksha 2026
 Unlike ticketed music festivals in the NCR, admission to Hardy Sandhu’s show at NSUT is free of monetary charge. To manage security and crowd capacity at the Sports Ground, the organizing committee requires all attendees to obtain a digital pass prior to entry.
 Access the Official Registration Channel: Open Instagram and navigate to the official festival aggregator handle, dufest_gram .
 Join the Broadcast Channel: Open the linked broadcast channel pinned on the profile page.
 Fill the Registration Form: Access the active Google Form or digital pass generation link shared within the broadcast updates.
 Submit Details: Provide valid personal identification information, including your full name, student ID number (if applicable), phone number, and email address.
 Download the Entry Pass: Once verified, a unique digital QR pass will be sent to your registered email or displayed on-screen. Save this pass on your mobile device for verification at the NSUT entry gates.
 Star Power and Valuation: Hardy Sandhu’s Commercial Footprint
 Hardy Sandhu—born Hardavinder Singh Sandhu—has established himself as one of modern Punjabi music’s most lucrative hitmakers. Transitioning from a promising First-Class cricket career to mainstream music and Bollywood acting, Sandhu commands an estimated net worth of ₹170 crore ($20.3 Million), as highlighted by NetWorthGyaan . 
 In addition to streaming royalties across platforms like Spotify and YouTube, Sandhu commands high live-performance fees. Commercial event booking figures curated by talent platforms such as Tring indicate that Sandhu charges approximately ₹31 lakh to ₹50 lakh per live performance or corporate gig. His appearance at Moksha 2026 brings high-budget commercial festival production to NSUT’s campus for a zero-cost public audience.
 Venue Infrastructure & Navigation Guide
 How to Reach NSUT Dwarka via Metro
 Nearest Station: De-board at Dwarka Mor Metro Station , situated on the Blue Line of the Delhi Metro network.
 Last-Mile Transport: From Dwarka Mor (Exit Gate 2), the NSUT campus is located approximately 1.2 kilometers away. Visitors can take an e-rickshaw or auto-rickshaw (a 5-minute ride) or walk directly along Azad Hind Fauj Marg to reach Gate No. 1.
 Alternative Routes: Commuters arriving via the Pink Line can interchange at Rajouri Garden to reach the Blue Line, while those coming from Gurgaon can use the Magenta Line to interchange at Janakpuri West.
 Campus Layout & Entry Gates
 Entry Gates: General visitors with digital passes will be directed through designated entry checkpoints (typically Gate 1 and Gate 2). Student volunteers and security personnel will scan QR codes at the gate.
 Concert Ground: The live performance will take place at the main NSUT Sports Ground , an open-air venue designed to accommodate large festival crowds with stage setups, light rigs, and emergency medical bays.
 Campus Festival Culture in Delhi NCR
 Moksha stands alongside IIT Delhi’s Rendezvous and Hindu College’s Mecca as one of the largest collegiate cultural festivals in North India. The 2026 edition continues NSUT’s tradition of hosting top-tier Indian performers, expanding the footprint of free cultural events across the NCR.
 Music enthusiasts looking to explore other live shows, food bazaars, and outdoor cultural events happening across the region can check out our comprehensive guides to free events and pop-up festivals in Delhi NCR and review our curated lineup of upcoming Delhi NCR winter concerts and live gigs .
 Concert Survival Tips for Attendees
 Arrive Early: Gates are expected to open during the late afternoon. Arriving by 3:30 PM to 4:00 PM ensures smooth security clearance before peak entry queues form.
 Carry Physical & Digital ID: Bring a government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar Card, Driver’s License, or Voter ID) along with your digital pass. College students should carry their physical institute ID cards.
 Prohibited Items: Bags, water bottles, sharp objects, power banks, professional camera gear, and outside food items are strictly prohibited inside the concert arena.
 Metro Timings: Plan your exit strategy in advance. The last Blue Line metro train toward Noida Electronic City / Vaishali typically departs Dwarka Mor around 11:00 PM.
